page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a baseline clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Cache resources include 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of L3 cache. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities and weak single-core execution. In single-core evaluations, such as the stress-ng single-core CPU test and Geekbench single-core score, the instance performs in the bottom 25%, with single-threaded gzip compression falling into the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-threaded benchmarks, including multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, consistently rank in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks also demonstrate average performance, as do database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core performance. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute delivery, though the lack of bundled local storage requires external block storage integration. This instance is appropriate for general-purpose workloads such as software compilation, multi-threaded data decompression, static web serving, and medium-scale database operations. It can also handle basic LLM inference for small to medium models, though it is constrained by CPU-only execution.
